title: Friday the 13th
build: G64 disk image: a one-line loader, a title program that loads at $2900, a 29,299-byte main program at $5800, two data files at $0C00 and $E000, and a 880-byte program at $0400. One sector on the disk has a bad checksum

records.c: switches the bitmap bit of $D011 off, moves the interrupt vector to $9398, sets the sprites to multicolour, and puts the video chip in bank 1 with the screen at $5400

the game's screen text as stored: the death message, the time-out message, the score lines, the win message, then the title, the question that opens the introduction, and a profile of each of the five counsellors, ending in PRESS FIRE BUTTON.
interrupt handler: a half-frame counter, then the sound routine that steps the three voices' note scripts and writes the SID
reloads the tick counter and steps each voice's script; a voice's counter at $0800, $0801 and $0802 reaches zero for the next note
